terminology_review.decision: Retain established chapter wording Wiederherstellung von Beziehungen and contextual body Wiederherstellung.
terminology_review.rationale: Considered Wiedergutmachung but rejected its narrower making-amends implication after consulting independent-index-en-de.json. In article21 explicit statements that the process may end in separation qualify Wiederherstellung and distinguish it from restoring the prior state. In article23 paragraph33 use contextual damages-being-repaired wording rather than implying guaranteed restoration. No global terminology substitution or index change is needed.
